analysis.reasonEn: The upward trend has continued for three consecutive sessions since the previous buy decision. RSI has recovered from the oversold territory to 44.6, and the MACD histogram has improved from negative territory to 0.1269. Although the volume ratio to the 5-day average is subdued at 0.45, the positive indicator momentum outweighs this.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Significantly below SMA100 ($70.87)/SMA200 ($79.50): Indicating weak medium-to-long term trend.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2296 → 0.1269): Improving after a dead cross, signaling weakening bearishness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $61.63): Sideways near the middle band, with a contracting band width of 16.58%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($67.49): Based on 20-day high, expectation of uptrend reversal if breached.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Forming Higher Low): Confirmation of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.45x): Subdued volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Consideration for entry due to RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement.
